solution.python:
from jifunze_lab import btc, lnd

channel = lnd("alice").channels()[0]
txid, index = channel["channel_point"].split(":")
print("channel point:", channel["channel_point"])
print("capacity (sats):", channel["capacity"])
tx = btc().getrawtransaction(txid, True)
output = tx["vout"][int(index)]
print("funding output (BTC):", output["value"])
print("script type:", output["scriptPubKey"]["type"])
